summary: Iter 96 — Full-stack verification of edit-in-place profile card rework on BOTH web and mobile (Expo web preview). Backend pytest: 8/9 PASSED (test_edit_in_place.py). Web UI PASSED all 7 scenarios on /org-listing for pugetsoundsailingsoc (CP, no logo, 2 photos, cover set): logo placeholder renders flag icon (edit-logo), tap opens image-menu with ONLY menu-upload (menu-crop=0, menu-remove=0 since no logo); edit-cover with existing cover opens menu with all 3 actions (upload+crop+remove); menu-crop opens crop-modal with crop-zoom + crop-save + crop-cancel; crop-cancel closes modal cleanly; gallery renders 6 slots total = 2 filled (gallery-slot-0/1) + 4 empty (gallery-empty-2..5) for CP; filled slot menu has upload+crop+remove; menu-remove triggers remove-confirm with yes/no; copy 'Tap the logo, banner, or a gallery slot below to edit your photos. Changes save automatically.' present. Mobile (Expo web preview, 390x844) PASSED same flow: profile-card-editor renders, edit-logo tap -> menu-upload only (no crop/remove, matches spec), edit-cover tap -> all 3 options, menu-crop opens the gesture crop screen with crop-save + crop-cancel (crop-modal testID is intentionally NOT set on mobile per spec), 6 gallery slots render (2 filled + 4 empty). Public /u/pugetsoundsailingsoc GET strips 'original' from each photo and returns cover_url. ONE BUG FOUND: Clearing cover_url on an org that has gallery photos triggers the legacy migration (directory_router.py L455-461) which auto-promotes photos[0] back to cover_url AND SHIFTS IT OUT OF the gallery. Verified end-to-end: PUT {cover_url:'', cover_original_url:''} → response shows cover=True; GET /org-listing/mine shows cover restored to photos[0] AND gallery photo count dropped from 2 to 1. Impact: user tapping Remove on cover appears to succeed, but on next load the cover reappears (sourced from first gallery photo) and that photo disappears from the gallery — breaks the Remove flow for CPs with gallery content and silently reorders their gallery.

critical.issue: Legacy cover-migration (directory_router.py:455-461) re-runs on EVERY mine-GET/PUT, not just once. When cover_url is empty and gallery has photos, it unconditionally promotes photos[0] to cover_url and removes it from gallery. This makes 'Remove cover' impossible for any CP that still has gallery photos (cover reappears as photos[0] on next load, and the gallery silently loses one entry). Fix: gate the migration on a one-time flag (e.g. `cover_migrated:true`) OR only run when the doc has NO cover_url field at all (vs empty string), so an explicit empty from the UI is respected.

Add a backend unit test asserting that PUT {cover_url:''} followed by GET /org-listing/mine returns cover_url=None AND preserves the full photos list unchanged for a CP that has gallery photos.

rca of the issue: Root cause of cover-remove bug: /api/org-listing/mine (directory_router.py L455) runs a legacy one-time cover migration guarded only by `not cover_url and gallery not empty`. The gate has no persistent 'already migrated' flag, so after a user intentionally clears cover_url via the new Remove UI, the next GET re-fires the migration which (a) promotes photos[0] → cover_url, (b) splices that photo out of the gallery, and (c) writes both back to Mongo. Reproduction: curl PUT {cover_url:'', cover_original_url:''} as a CP with photos → curl GET /org-listing/mine → cover_url is non-null, photos count decremented by 1. Mitigation: either (1) set a persistent `cover_migrated:true` on first promotion and gate the migration on `!cover_migrated`, or (2) detect explicit-empty vs never-set (e.g. check `'cover_url' in doc` vs `doc['cover_url'] in ('', None)`) and only migrate when the field has never been set, or (3) remove the auto-migration entirely now that all legacy orgs have presumably been migrated and add a one-off backfill script instead.
